The map shows the meadow is enclosed — the only opening is at (11,3) leading up to row 1-2. The chest is at (11,1). The pass is now open (day 5). I need to walk to (11,3) then up to (11,1).

The notice board at (3,7) is blocking but irrelevant now. Let me just go to the chest. The interact button issue remains — but maybe the chest opens by walking onto it or interacting. Let me try interact with no button field, and also try walking to the chest tile.

args.approach: It's day 5 and the pass is open; skip the notice board entirely and walk the east corridor to the chest at (11,1). Try interact with no button field (button may be optional), then walk onto the chest tile as fallback.
